planning_notes: Board is forced to arduino:avr:uno and all provided/explicitly wired endpoints are preserved: A1(LM35), A0(MQ-2), D2(flame input), D6(buzzer), D13(red LED), D12(green LED), D4/D5(TM1637).

Pin D2 is treated as a digital_input because it is the dedicated flame sensor terminal and the requirement describes it as triggering the alarm level; electrical polarity/active level is not specified, so the model must align to actual wiring without additional inversion at the request level.
LM35 and MQ-2 are both configured as analog_input; no explicit scale/offset calibration is provided, so calibration conversion to °C/smoke units must be done in SysML using the raw adc_count values.

TM1637 is configured as tm1637_number (single numeric selection) using clk=D4 and dio=D5; the model decides what number (alert level ID and key value) to show, including valid range handling and any overwrite sequencing.
Buzzer is configured as tone_output with initial 0; the SysML model must implement intermittent on/off behavior for the fire alert using elapsed_ms (device request provides only the tone channel).

Serial output is configured only for the fire alert trigger (alarm level). The application must format exactly the chosen typed values per SysML; no fixed text lines were specified in the requirements.
Control period is set to 10 ms as a scheduling granularity. Any report cadence or buzzer intermittent pattern must be implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多传感器火灾预警系统，使用温度传感器 LM35（A1）、烟雾传感器 MQ-2（A0）、火焰传感器 D2、蜂鸣器 D6、红色 LED D13、绿色 LED D12、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和串口。系统将预警分为正常、关注、警报三级：任一指标轻微超限进入关注，多个指标超限或火焰传感器触发进入警报。数码管显示当前等级编号和关键值；警报级下蜂鸣器持续间歇报警并串口输出 fire alert。
